title: Aldrovandi Digital Twin
objectives: This experiment is set in the digital twin of the exhibition "L'altro Rinascimento. Ulisse Aldrovandi e le meraviglie del mondo" and aims to assess the effectiveness of the set-up
audience: The test involves a population of different visitors who have not already visited the original exhibition
actions: The visitor will freely explore the exhibition environment, as in a traditional visit
measureDescription: We want to study and understand which are the paths and the navigation styles visitors usually follow
